newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor up on specultaive buying.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor up on specultaive buying.

text.p: Indian castorseed June delivery rose to 1,191/1,192 rupees per quintal from 1,185 rupees on renewed speculative buying on Monday, traders said.
"Traded volumes were quite low and light short covering by bear operators lifted prices," one trader said.
Traders in the producing centres of Gujarat region in western India were inactive on Monday to protest the detention of a Hindu leader by the state government.
"Closure of the market in Gujarat has led to dull trading in the Bombay market also," said a trader.
"Market delivery remained untraded as outstanding position is already squared up," he said.

Groundnut oil rose 3/4 rupees to 342/343 rupees per 10 kg on speculative buying triggered off by hopes that Indian government might hike import duty on edible oil in the federal budget scheduled to be announced on Friday.
Import duty is 20 percent and traders said they expected it to be to be hiked to 30 percent.
Imported palm-oil was steady at 284/285 rupees per 10 kg and traders said the market undertone was firm on expectations of an import duty hike in the budget.
